capabilities: Generate unique incremental IDs with configurable prefixes
Insert a defined ID into a note via a command
Reuse the same generated ID multiple times within a template
intentEvidence: A plugin that allows you to generate a unique id like in Jira.
motivation: The author built it while starting to use the Kanban plugin and wanting to reference specific notes in commits.
problem: Notes lack stable short identifiers, making it hard to reference a specific note from outside the vault, such as in commit messages.

relations.evidence: you can add the code to the templater and do it automatically
I'm starting to use the kanban plugin and I want to have the option to reference a specific note
Generate Jira-like IDs for each note

summary: Generates Jira-style unique IDs with custom prefixes (e.g. DN-1) and inserts them into notes via commands or Templater templates.
